newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan asset-backed shares rise on reassessment.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan asset-backed shares rise on reassessment.

text.p: Taiwan's asset-backed shares rose sharply at mid-session on Thursday following news that the finance ministry would allow businesses to reassess the values of their assets bought before 1979, brokers said.
YWith 80 minutes left, Taiwan Cement was up T$1.50 to T$63, Sinkong Spinning gained the daily seven-percent limit or T$5 to T$79 and Formosa Rubber also rose limit-up or T$2.90 to T$45.70.
